messages.subject: legend for geom_vline
parts:
I need to plot densities and add vlines to mark the mean and the median of the 
distributions.
I am using linteype to distinguish the statistics.
I am unable to produce a legend for explaining
the linetype used for mean and median.
What needs to be changed in the following piece of code?

-=-=-=-=

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

mydf <- data.frame(
  x=c(rnorm(100),rnorm(100,1)),
  f=rep(c("a","b"),each=100)
  )

meanmed <- 
  mydf %>%
  group_by(f) %>%
  summarise(mean=mean(x),median=median(x)) %>%
  gather(statistic,val,-f)

mydf %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=x,fill=f))+geom_density(alpha=0.3) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=val,color=f,linetype=statistic),meanmed) +
  scale_linetype_discrete(guide="legend")

messages.author: e83d54ec65b5b8e6
messages.subject: Re: legend for geom_vline
parts:
Found the answer myself:
Just do

  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=val,color=f,linetype=statistic),meanmed,show_guide=TRUE)

and remove the last line
